scope_note: Every literal descriptor occurrence is retained, including historical and path-relative records. Missing descriptor bodies are not all active runtime inputs. Fixed154 completeness does not imply complete operational dependency closure.
source_read_scope_clarification: The descriptor inventory pass did not traverse external bodies. Separately selected upstream license/version metadata and the original analysis provenance map were inspected as source-rights evidence; no referenced input, key, graph, model or target body was opened.

static_import_scope.interpretation: Exact source/line/module/level/names occurrences are retained, including nested/deferred imports. Relative names were joined to supplied package file candidates; absolute names list every matching supplied source candidate or are external to this snapshot (including standard-library imports). Candidate file presence does not establish Python import resolution or active-path necessity. This is not an installed/version/qualified-runtime inventory. Dynamically captured helpers, distributions/native dependencies, runtime namespaces and environment admission remain external.
